# netbox_power_outlet_template (Resource)

A power outlet template of a device type or module type (dcim.poweroutlettemplate).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/poweroutlettemplate/):

> A template for a power outlet that will be created on all instantiations of the parent device type. See the power outlet documentation for more detail.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_manufacturer" "test" {
  name = "test-manufacturer"
}

resource "netbox_device_type" "test" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.test.id
  model           = "test-device-type"
}

resource "netbox_power_port_template" "test" {
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.test.id
  name           = "test-power-port-template"
  type           = "iec-60320-c14"
}

resource "netbox_power_outlet_template" "test" {
  device_type_id         = netbox_device_type.test.id
  name                   = "test-power-outlet-template"
  type                   = "iec-60320-c13"
  power_port_template_id = netbox_power_port_template.test.id
  feed_leg               = "A"
  label                  = "test-label"
  description            = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `color_hex` (String) RGB color in hex (e.g. ff0000).
- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `feed_leg` (String) Phase of the upstream feed this outlet is mapped to. One of: A, B, C.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `module_type_id` (Number) Id of the module type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `power_port_id` (Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of power_port_template_id.
- `power_port_template_id` (Number) Id of the power port template this outlet draws from.
- `type` (String) Outlet type as its NetBox slug, e.g. iec-60320-c13, nema-5-15r, CS8364C (any of NetBox's power outlet type choices).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_power_outlet_template.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_power_outlet_template.test 123
```
